#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    class Task {
    public:
        class Maxflow {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int t, rev;
                long long cap, f;
                Edge(int t, int rev, long long cap) : t(t), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
            };
            std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> graph;
            Maxflow(int n) {
                graph.resize(n);
            }
            void addEdge(int s, int t, long long cap) {
                graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, (int)graph[t].size(), cap));
                graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, (int)graph[s].size() - 1, 0));
            }
            bool dinicBFS(int src, int dest, std::vector<int>& dist) {
                std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
                dist[src] = 0;
                std::queue<int> Q;
                Q.push(src);
                while (!Q.empty()) {
                    int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
                    for (auto& e : graph[u]) {
                        if (dist[e.t] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                            dist[e.t] = dist[u] + 1;
                            Q.push(e.t);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return dist[dest] >= 0;
            }
            long long dinicDFS(std::vector<int>& ptr, std::vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, long long f) {
                if (u == dest) return f;
                for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
                    auto& e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
                    if (dist[e.t] == dist[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                        long long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, e.t, std::min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                        if (df > 0) {
                            e.f += df;
                            graph[e.t][e.rev].f -= df;
                            return df;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            }
            long long maxFlow(int src, int dest) {
                long long flow = 0;
                std::vector<int> dist(graph.size());
                while (dinicBFS(src, dest, dist)) {
                    std::vector<int> ptr(graph.size(), 0);
                    while (true) {
                        long long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, src, LLONG_MAX);
                        if (df == 0) break;
                        flow += df;
                    }
                }
                return flow;
            }
        };

        class MinCostFlow {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
                Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int rev) : to(to), f(0), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev) {}
            };
            std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> graph;
            MinCostFlow(int n) {
                graph.resize(n);
            }
            void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
                graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, cap, cost, (int)graph[t].size()));
                graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, 0, -cost, (int)graph[s].size() - 1));
            }
            void bellmanFord(int s, std::vector<int>& dist, std::vector<int>& prevnode, std::vector<int>& prevedge, std::vector<int>& curflow) {
                int n = (int)graph.size();
                std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
                dist[s] = 0;
                curflow[s] = INT_MAX;
                std::vector<bool> inqueue(n, false);
                std::queue<int> q;
                q.push(s);
                inqueue[s] = true;
                while (!q.empty()) {
                    int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                    inqueue[u] = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
                        auto& e = graph[u][i];
                        if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                        int v = e.to;
                        int ndist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if (dist[v] > ndist) {
                            dist[v] = ndist;
                            prevnode[v] = u;
                            prevedge[v] = i;
                            curflow[v] = std::min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                            if (!inqueue[v]) {
                                inqueue[v] = true;
                                q.push(v);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            std::vector<int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
                int n = (int)graph.size();
                std::vector<int> dist(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n);
                int flow = 0;
                long long flowCost = 0;
                while (flow < maxf) {
                    bellmanFord(s, dist, prevnode, prevedge, curflow);
                    if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
                    int df = std::min(curflow[t], maxf - flow);
                    flow += df;
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                        auto& e = graph[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                        e.f += df;
                        graph[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                        flowCost += df * e.cost;
                    }
                }
                return {flow, (int)flowCost};
            }
        };

        void solve(std::istream& in, std::ostream& out) {
            int n, m, k, c, d;
            in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
            std::vector<int> pos(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                int x; in >> x;
                pos[x - 1]++;
            }
            const int T = 100;
            int totalNodes = (T + 1) * n + 2;
            MinCostFlow mf(totalNodes);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (pos[i] > 0)
                    mf.addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, k, 0);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, (T + 1) * n + 1, 1, c * i);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int a, b; in >> a >> b;
                a--; b--;
                for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                    int cost = 0;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + a, 1 + (j + 1) * n + b, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                        mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + b, 1 + (j + 1) * n + a, 1, l * l * d - cost);
                        cost = l * l * d;
                    }
                }
            }
            auto flowAndCost = mf.minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * n + 1, k);
            out << flowAndCost[1] << "\n";
        }
    };

    static long TIME_START, TIME_END;

    static void main() {
        std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        std::cin.tie(nullptr);
        auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        int usedMemoryBefore = 0; // Not directly measurable in standard C++
        Task t;
        t.solve(std::cin, std::cout);
        auto end_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        // Memory measurement not directly available
        std::cerr << "Time used: " << std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end_time - start_time).count() << ".\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    Main::main();
    return 0;
}
